evidence: The thickness of the NiO layers has been measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry. The morphology of the deposits has been observed by scanning (SEM) and transmission (TEM) electron microscopies. The chemical composition has been determined by energy-dispersive x-ray spectroscopy (EDX). The crystalline structure has been studied by selected area electron diffraction (SAED). Root mean square roughness (Rrms) measurements have been performed by atomic force microscopy (AFM). The photoelectrochemical properties were investigated by cyclic voltammetry.
